items.title: On Agentic Manipulation Policies
items.authors: Chen Chen, Omid Bagherieh, Naveen Nikamanth Appiah Balaji et al.
items.abstract: Recent work on robot manipulation has focused on specialist policies trained on demonstrations. We show that generalist AI models can control manipulators more reliably than specialist policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs).
